capabilities: Visualize the vault hierarchy as a 2D radial atlas rooted at the vault or any folder
Explore the vault as a 3D galaxy link graph with fly-through navigation
Highlight hierarchy routes and internal note links on hover
Search and jump to notes, folders, and unresolved links
Inspect node and link details, including backlinks and outgoing links
disambiguation: Not a geographic world map; the "world map" is the vault's folder hierarchy drawn as concentric rings.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; requires manual installation from release assets. Runs fully locally with no network services or telemetry, and its panels are bilingual (English and Chinese).
intentEvidence: The current project is based on Longwind1984/galaxy-view.
motivation: The author built it for their own knowledge base, miniWorldModel, which grew large enough that they needed a way to present its structure to others.
problem: Obsidian's Graph View shows note-to-note links but does not foreground folder hierarchy, while mind-map tools show hierarchy without rich note linking.

relations.evidence: Mini World Map builds on that Galaxy-style 3D graph foundation

summary: Vault visualization plugin that renders the folder hierarchy as a 2D radial atlas with link overlays, or as a 3D galaxy link graph.
